name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Only run when the release workflow signals that a release should be performed
    if: ${{ env.PERFORM_RELEASE == 'true' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Parse tag components
        id: parse_tag
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          MAJOR=$(echo $TAG | cut -d. -f1 | sed 's/v//')
          MINOR=$(echo $TAG | cut -d. -f2)
          PATCH=$(echo $TAG | cut -d. -f3)
          echo "major=$MAJOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "minor=$MINOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "patch=$PATCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Force‑push docs branch
        run: |
          git push --force origin ${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.tag }}:refs/heads/docs/v${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.major }}.${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.minor }}

      - name: Create Gitbook variant (for x.y.0 releases)
        if: ${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.patch == '0' }}
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
        run: |
          VARIANT_NAME="V${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.major }}.${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.minor }} - Rocky Romp"
          curl -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/${GITBOOK_SPACE_ID}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"name\": \"$VARIANT_NAME\", \"branch\": \"docs/v${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.major }}.${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.minor }}\"}"

      - name: Verify docs branch exists
        run: |
          git fetch origin docs/v${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.major }}.${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.minor }}
          echo "Branch docs/v${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.major }}.${{ steps.parse_tag.outputs.minor }} is present."
